title: Concentration of Stochastic System Trajectories with Time-varying Contraction Conditions
summary: We establish two concentration inequalities for nonlinear stochastic system under time-varying contraction conditions. The key to our approach is an energy function termed Averaged Moment Generating Function (AMGF). By combining it with incremental stability analysis, we develop a concentration inequality that bounds the deviation between the stochastic system state and its deterministic counterpart.
